title: Flip 2×2 Blocks to Match
src: Media.net OA, IIT Guwahati (from a candidate's note), question 1. Also in the Media.net PDF write-up (problem 3).
body:
You are given two N × N matrices A and B whose entries are 0 or 1. In one operation you pick any 2 × 2 block of adjacent cells in A and flip all four of its entries (0 ↔ 1). You may do this any number of times.

Return 1 if A can be turned into B, otherwise 0.

Function to complete

Complete canConvert(A, B). It returns 1 if A can become B, else 0.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: First line: N. Next N lines: matrix A. Next N lines: matrix B.
cons: 2 ≤ N ≤ 500 (the reported limit was 10<sup>3</sup>; the mock uses 500 to keep test files small)

spec.returns: 1 if A can become B, else 0

wrong.why: checks only that the number of differing cells is a multiple of 4
after the greedy pass, checks the last row but forgets the last column

samples.ex: Only the bottom-right cell differs. Every flip changes four cells, and no combination of flips changes that one cell alone, so the answer is 0.
